raw_lines: There is a cruel irony in it.
eclipses to the exact day could not
mathematics, and the one cycle that
truly mattered slipped right past them.
It makes you wonder what we are missing
right now. And here is what most people
get wrong. The Maya never disappeared.
Standing here a thousand years ago, you
would see farmers, scribes, and kings
Today, their descendants number in the
languages, still farming the same land.
The cities fell. The people endured.
